changelog: Compact profile and user menu with native account controls and an Appearance opt-out. Cancels stale hero data/artwork after account or server changes, scopes repeat history and Play intent to each account/server, and prevents foreign-origin credentials being used. Explicit library names never fall back to unrelated libraries; blank selection uses available movie/TV views. Missing views, failed enumeration, or all excluded titles retain native Home without repeated requests.
description: A unified cinematic Jellyfin Web customization with a profile-forward login screen, Plex-inspired theme, and rotating library-driven home hero.
name: Cinematic UI
overview: Cinematic login and home experience for Jellyfin Web
